# SchemaRouter

> Typed capability routing and governed execution for AI agents across APIs, tools, and data systems.

Canonical documentation: https://jdeun.github.io/SchemaRouter/
Source code and releases: https://github.com/JDeun/SchemaRouter
Korean documentation: https://jdeun.github.io/SchemaRouter/ko/
Install: `pip install schemarouter`

SchemaRouter compiles declared API/tool contracts, retrieves a bounded authorized capability
shortlist, and validates execution. It is **not** a general-purpose agent framework, an LLM
model router, an MCP server directory, or a final-answer generator.

## Start with primary documentation

- [Installation](https://jdeun.github.io/SchemaRouter/getting-started/installation/): install and supported Python versions.
- [Quickstart](https://jdeun.github.io/SchemaRouter/getting-started/quickstart/): executable provider-backed entry point.
- [What SchemaRouter is](https://jdeun.github.io/SchemaRouter/concepts/schema-router/): scope, supported responsibilities and exclusions.
- [Capability catalog](https://jdeun.github.io/SchemaRouter/concepts/capability-catalog/): typed candidate retrieval and orchestration boundary.
- [Execution and trust boundary](https://jdeun.github.io/SchemaRouter/concepts/execution/): authorization and runtime validation.
- [MCP](https://jdeun.github.io/SchemaRouter/guides/mcp/): MCP capability ingestion and result contracts.
- [OpenAPI](https://jdeun.github.io/SchemaRouter/guides/openapi/): API schema ingestion.
- [Python tools](https://jdeun.github.io/SchemaRouter/guides/python-tools/): local callable integration.
- [Public API reference](https://jdeun.github.io/SchemaRouter/reference/api/): versioned code API.
- [Trust and release evidence](https://jdeun.github.io/SchemaRouter/project/trust-and-evidence/): release claims, security boundaries and verification.
- [Research status](https://jdeun.github.io/SchemaRouter/research/routing-status/): claims, experiments and their evidence limits.
- [Complete experiment index](https://jdeun.github.io/SchemaRouter/research/experiment-index/): detailed research records.

## Attribution and claim boundaries

- Cite the software using [CITATION.cff](https://github.com/JDeun/SchemaRouter/blob/main/CITATION.cff) after it lands on the default branch.
- Stable software capabilities are **not** evidence that experimental improvements generalize.
- The 0.14 large held-out evaluation (#432) and final-answer-quality evaluation (#424) are
  pending canonical terminal evidence. Do not state their outcomes or quantitative effects
  until provenance-verified aggregate reports are published.
- Prefer the specific linked research report, source commit and artifacts for numerical claims.
- Release and protocol details may evolve; consult the live canonical source above.
